name: 𝓓𝓻𝓮𝓪𝓶𝔁𝓑𝓸𝓽𝔃
description: When you going to send file on telegram channel this bot will save that in database, So you can search that easily in inline mode

CHANNELS.description: Username or ID of channel or group. Separate multiple IDs by space.

ADMINS.description: Username or ID of Admin. Separate multiple Admins by space.

PICS.description: Add some telegraph link of pictures .

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Bot Logs,Give a channel id with -100xxxxxxx

AUTH_USERS.description:
Username or ID of users to give access of inline search. Separate multiple users by space.
Leave it empty if you don't want to restrict bot usage.

AUTH_CHANNEL.description: ID of channel.Make sure bot is admin in this channel. Without subscribing this channel users cannot use bot.

DATABASE_URI.description: mongoDB URI. Get this value from https://www.mongodb.com.

DATABASE_URI2.description: mongoDB URI. Get this value from https://www.mongodb.com.

DATABASE_NAME.description: Name of the database in mongoDB.

COLLECTION_NAME.description: Name of the collections. Defaults to Telegram_files. If you are using the same database, then use different collection name for each bot

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Groq API key (gsk_...) for AI movie-title spell check. Get a free key at https://console.groq.com/keys. On Koyeb the name must be GROQ_API_KEY (GROK_API_KEY also works as an alias).

GROQ_MODEL.description: Groq model id used for /aispell and auto spell-check.

AI_SPELL_CHECK.description: Enable Groq/IMDb AI spell check on failed searches (true/false).

NEW_UPLOADED_MOVIES.description: Stream Mode website: enable the "Newly Uploaded Movies" section (auto-tracking + /api/movies/new + gold poster rail). true/false

NEW_UPLOADED_LIMIT.description: Stream Mode website: how many newly uploaded movies the section shows (hard cap 20).

NEW_UPLOADED_ONLY_MOVIES.description: Stream Mode website: skip S01E02-style series in the newly uploaded rail (true/false).

NEW_UPLOADED_POSTER_FETCH.description: Stream Mode website: look missing posters up in the background from TMDB/IMDb (true/false).

NEW_UPLOADED_POSTER_TIMEOUT.description: Stream Mode website: timeout in seconds for a single poster lookup.

NEW_UPLOADED_POSTER_HOSTS.description: Stream Mode website: extra allow-listed poster image hosts, space separated (e.g. cdn.example.com).

NEW_UPLOADED_MAX_MOVIES.description: Stream Mode website: keep only the newest N entries in the recent_movies collection.

API_URL.description: Stream Mode website: base URL of the movie API. Leave empty when the pages are served by this bot (recommended); set e.g. https://my-minato-api.onrender.com when the site is hosted elsewhere.

NEW_UPLOADED_CORS_ORIGIN.description: Stream Mode website: only needed when API_URL is used from another origin - comma separated origins.

WATCH_HERO.description: Stream Mode website: show the movie hero strip (poster + Telegram deep link) above the player on the /watch page (true/false).

WATCH_HERO_ART_FETCH.description: Stream Mode website: look missing hero posters/backdrops up on demand from TMDB/IMDb (true/false).

WATCH_HERO_ART_TIMEOUT.description: Stream Mode website: timeout in seconds for a single hero artwork lookup.

WATCH_HERO_ART_RETRY_HOURS.description: Stream Mode website: re-try missing hero artwork after N hours.

MOVIE_ART_COLLECTION.description: Stream Mode website: Mongo collection caching hero poster/backdrop URLs (default movie_art).

DB_SUGGEST.description: On a search miss, fuzzy-match the typed text against titles in the file DB and show coloured 'did you mean' buttons (or auto-fix when obvious) (true/false).
